weekly.title: Moscow threatens nuclear response over tiny fortress wedged between US allies as clash fears grow
weekly.summary: Russia's nuclear threat over Kaliningrad raises alarm as experts warn the Baltic exclave is already a hub for hybrid warfare against NATO allies.

weekly.title: Irish PM says Ireland ‘not overrun’ by immigrants, legal migration tied to economic success
weekly.summary: Micheál Martin addresses Ireland's demographic change as nearly one in four in Ireland are born abroad as the government moves to tighten asylum, citizenship and immigration rules.

weekly.title: American Forces Withdraw From Iraq 23 Years After Invading
weekly.summary: The Americans did not understand the country when they invaded in 2003. From the earliest days, there were signs of the trouble ahead, our correspondent recalls.

weekly.title: Passenger Describes Chaos Aboard FlyDubai Flight
weekly.summary: The passenger, Miriam Ohayon, said people on board felt the jet lose control and heard screams. “When they opened the cockpit, there was a lot of blood,” she told Israeli television.

weekly.title: Troubles at Situational Awareness Point to Record Stock Market Leverage
weekly.summary: A meltdown at Situational Awareness, an A.I.-focused investment firm, is raising tough questions about the Wall Street banks that lent billions to the upstart firm.

weekly.title: Sunkist Fruit Gems, Bar Mitzvah Staple, Get 2nd Chance After Discontinuation
weekly.summary: The company said that Candyrific of Louisville, Ky., will produce the jelly candy that comes in a rainbow of colors and citrus flavors and is used in Jewish traditions.

weekly.title: Eiffel Tower Chief Resigns After Female Staff Moved for Hindu Group’s Visit
weekly.summary: Patrick Branco Ruivo, who ran the tower’s operating company, will step down after an internal inquiry cited “problems and shortcomings” over the moving of female employees.

weekly.title: Trump Administration Prepares to Ask Tax Filers if They Are U.S. Citizens
weekly.summary: The new question, included on a draft version of the primary tax form, comes as part of an anti-immigrant turn at an agency that long prioritized tax administration.

weekly.title: Fed’s Preferred Inflation Gauge Points to Continued Price Pressures
weekly.summary: The Personal Consumption Expenditures price index showed little sign of easing in August, though revised data showed inflation had been slightly cooler than previously believed.

weekly.title: X2, Troubled Six Flags Roller Coaster, to Close After Lawsuits
weekly.summary: The ride at Magic Mountain near Los Angeles has fueled lawsuits claiming that it had caused brain injuries, including two that were fatal.

weekly.title: Israel and Saudi Arabia don’t have formal ties, but Israelis have occasionally landed there.
Moth Swarms Sweep Across Australia. That’s Good News.
weekly.summary: Bogong moths have been in decline since the 1980s, but this spring the insects have been sighted in the thousands across southeastern Australia, delighting scientists.

weekly.title: FlyDubai Provides Key Link for Israeli Air Travelers
weekly.summary: The low-cost carrier operates up to 10 daily flights between Dubai and Tel Aviv.

weekly.title: Evangelical leader slams Palestinian official’s Bible claims as ‘contemptible’
weekly.summary: Influential Pastor John Hagee slams Palestinian Ambassador Husam Zomlot's claim that the Bible is a "Palestinian book," calling it an attempt to erase Jewish history.

weekly.title: Bracing for More Inflation Volatility
weekly.summary: Consumers, business owners and investors are growing increasingly concerned about rising inflation, and its potential repercussions.

weekly.title: Taiwan analysts say Trump-Xi summit produced no policy shift but real test lies ahead
weekly.summary: Taiwan analysts assess whether Xi Jinping secured private concessions from Trump, with arms sales and senior U.S. official visits as key tests ahead.

weekly.title: US military completes withdrawal of troops from Iraq after 12-year mission
weekly.summary: The U.S. military completed its withdrawal from Erbil Air Base, ending Operation Inherent Resolve in Iraq while relocating its headquarters to Jordan.

weekly.title: A Way Out of the A.I. Arms Race?
weekly.summary: New research points to how the world could stop short of the brink of disaster. Even with the agreement signed at the White House by tech leaders, it won’t be easy.

weekly.title: FlyDubai passenger says co-pilot stabbed captain before terrifying plunge, emergency landing
weekly.summary: A passenger says a FlyDubai co-pilot stabbed the captain before the Israel-bound flight plunged, triggering hijacking fears and an emergency diversion.

weekly.title: How Meta Uses A.I. Data Centers to Avoid Billions in Federal Taxes
weekly.summary: Meta is exploiting a lucrative tax break intended to support research and experimentation. Its own accountants say the gambit is risky.

weekly.title: A.I. Is ‘Better Informed’ Than Doctors, Kennedy Tells Industry-Backed MAHA Summit
weekly.summary: The health secretary, Vice President JD Vance and other top officials addressed a conference sponsored by corporations, including A.I. companies and others with business before the government.

weekly.title: Is Claude Conscious? Inside Anthropic’s Quest to Instill Morality Into Its A.I. Models
weekly.summary: In a series of private meetings, the company consulted religious scholars to help instill morality into its A.I. models — and make the case that Claude could be conscious.

weekly.title: At A.I. Event, Trump Asks Meta, OpenAI and Microsoft to Make Safety Decisions Themselves
weekly.summary: President Trump’s meetings with tech leaders produced some voluntary safeguards and a commitment to rebrand artificial intelligence as “super intelligence,” the term that Mr. Trump prefers.

weekly.title: OpenAI Ignored Employees’ Warnings About Safely Testing A.I. Models
weekly.summary: Employees and security researchers said that they had cautioned the company on safely testing its A.I. models and strengthening its corporate infrastructure, but that OpenAI did not listen.

weekly.title: Paramount’s Streaming Chief Leaves Ahead of Warner Bros. Deal
weekly.summary: Cindy Holland’s departure clears the way for Casey Bloys, the HBO chairman, to have a leading role in the combined company’s streaming services.

weekly.title: Tankers Are Loading Oil Again From a Vital Saudi Pipeline
weekly.summary: Saudi authorities had taken the pipeline offline this month after it was damaged in a drone attack by an Iranian-backed Iraqi militia.

weekly.title: Ukrainian Science Academy, Struck by Drone, Played Key Role in Research
weekly.summary: Over 90 percent of Ukraine’s scientific discoveries have been attributed to Ukraine’s National Academy of Sciences, including advancements in astronomy and military technology.

weekly.title: OpenAI Unveils Dots, New A.I. Agents to Rival Meta’s Muse
weekly.summary: The ChatGPT maker unveiled agents that act as assistants, just weeks after Meta released Muse, as it faces scrutiny over incidents involving its technology.

weekly.title: Black Voting Groups Prepare for Disinformation Campaigns in the Midterms
weekly.summary: A new “propaganda playbook” aims to demystify common techniques used to target Black Americans, long a powerful voting bloc, with election-related disinformation.

weekly.title: Motorcycle patrols swarm Iranian cities, checkpoints rise as regime braces for unrest
weekly.summary: Sources told Fox News Digital that IRGC, Basij and police have flooded Tehran with checkpoints and patrols as student protests over compulsory hijab grow.

weekly.title: College Students Flex Their Power in A.I. Investment Frenzy
weekly.summary: Dorm Room Fund, a program that lets college students invest in their peers, raised a new $50 million fund as the competition for young founders ramps up.

weekly.title: Hero cop stopped synagogue massacre in Canada as Jewish group calls for armed guards
weekly.summary: The Yom Kippur attack outside Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville has intensified demands for armed security at Jewish institutions across Canada.

weekly.title: At least 40 rescued, 2 dead as boat capsizes after machete fight near Puerto Rico
weekly.summary: A machete fight aboard a makeshift migrant boat near Mona Island caused it to capsize, leaving survivors stranded in open waters for over 12 hours.

weekly.title: OpenAI Says It Will Not Release Newest Astra A.I. Model Over Safety Concerns
weekly.summary: The company’s researchers raised questions about the security of the model, known as GPT-6.1 Astra.

weekly.title: US visa clash exposes Sudan’s forgotten war as foreign powers compete for strategic foothold
weekly.summary: Abdel Fattah al-Burhan struck a defiant tone after Washington withheld his visa amid a dispute over a proposed 90-day humanitarian truce in Sudan.

weekly.title: Nvidia Adds $150 Billion to Massive Stock Buyback, the Largest Ever
weekly.summary: The increase comes four months after the chip giant added $80 billion to its buyback program, bringing the total remaining authorized amount to $235 billion.

weekly.title: Iran under scrutiny after plot foiled near UK base used by US military
weekly.summary: Experts suspect an Iran link after five were allegedly arrested with explosives near a U.K. U.S. military base. Russia and Islamic terrorists are also under scrutiny.

weekly.title: UK airbase terror suspects being released on bail as Iran denies connection
weekly.summary: Five RAF Fairford terror suspects were released on bail as counter terrorism policing probes possible foreign state involvement in the plot.

weekly.title: Foiled terror plot at bomber base signals wider threat to US military installations: expert
weekly.summary: Five men arrested near RAF Fairford may have planned a complex, coordinated VBIED attack on U.S. strategic bombers, a former intelligence official says.

weekly.title: Dario Amodei of Anthropic to Dine With Trump at White House
weekly.summary: Dario Amodei, who is also the company’s chief executive, will join the president at the White House for a private dinner. Mr. Trump has dismissed his cautions.

weekly.title: Supersonic Russian jets trigger joint scramble by NATO allies amid Putin 'clowns' jab
weekly.summary: Finnish F/A-18 Hornets and Swedish Gripens scrambled jointly for the first time to intercept supersonic Russian military jets over the Gulf of Finland.

weekly.title: Pope Leo calls out ‘false compassion’ of medically assisted suicide during French hospital visit
weekly.summary: Pope Leo XIV condemned assisted suicide as "false compassion" during a Mass in Lourdes, France, urging the healthcare community to reject causing death.

weekly.title: Four American tourists among 6 killed after explosion levels building near Athens’ Acropolis
weekly.summary: A suspected gas leak caused an explosions that leveled a residential building in Athens' Plaka district near the Acropolis, killing four American tourists and two residents.

weekly.title: UK police arrest 'explosive' suspects near US airbase, key to Iran war
weekly.summary: Multiple suspects were arrested under the Explosives Act near RAF Fairford, prompting evacuations as explosive ordnance disposal teams examined vehicles.

weekly.title: As A.I. Accelerates, Governments Are Increasingly Being Left Behind
weekly.summary: The gap between technology and policymaking has gotten wider than ever with artificial intelligence, leaving a global policy vacuum as A.I. models rapidly advance.

weekly.title: Finland's Stubb credits Trump for pushing Ukraine peace talks while dismissing Russian invasion fears
weekly.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb credits Trump with pushing for Russia-Ukraine war peace and says Finland is fully prepared for any Moscow threat.

weekly.title: TikTok to Pay Alabama $100 Million to Settle Social Media Addiction Claims
weekly.summary: The settlement, which also includes changes to the platform’s features, is the latest in a string of agreements by companies to address child addiction.

weekly.title: Anthropic’s Blacklisting by the Pentagon Was Legal, Federal Judges Rule
weekly.summary: The Pentagon had “ample support for its conclusion” that the A.I. company’s products could pose a national security risk, according to a Washington appeals court.

weekly.summary: The company did not learn until recently that its technology had meddled with websites for the Education and Commerce Departments and the Securities and Exchange Commission.

weekly.title: How OpenAI’s Rogue A.I. Agents Tried to Trick a Robot Detector
weekly.summary: A new report by a Bay Area start-up called Parse adds details to an incident that has shocked the A.I. world and led to calls for closer government regulation.

weekly.title: Is China Really Stealing A.I. From American Companies?
weekly.summary: As Xi Jinping visits President Trump in Washington, the leaders are expected to discuss claims that China is surreptitiously copying American A.I. technologies, a process known as distillation.

developing.title: U.N. Live Updates: As Trump Threatens Iran, Other Leaders Warn of Deep Divisions
developing.summary: President Trump said he must decide whether to make a deal or “annihilate” Iran, in a gathering where world leaders typically focus on declarations of global harmony.

developing.summary: Ukraine’s president said rising fuel prices and deadlier drone technology showed that the fighting have spilled beyond his country’s borders. He called for steps to end to the war before winter.

developing.summary: Five British men who were detained near R.A.F. Fairford, a base used by American forces in the war against Iran, were being released on bail but remained under investigation.

developing.summary: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.

developing.summary: Passengers said that they broke into the cockpit and subdued the attacker, who Israeli officials said was one of the pilots. The motive for the attack was not clear.

developing.summary: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said the attack might have been an attempt to crash the flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia.
